1.consolidated_definition: Almuerzo rápido. Comida corta que se toma al mediodía, de uso en oficinas y sesiones de trabajo. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. San Juan de Puerto Rico. Highways, y quick lunch en restaurantes de plástico. Distribuidores automáticos de coke, cigarros y gas. Shopping centers y edificios lujosos con nombre de bancos extranjeros (Proceso.com, consultado 14-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Midday snack or brief meal taken during office hours or work sessions. A colloquialism of North American origin, relatively uncommon in formal contexts. In San Juan, Puerto Rico, it refers to a quick lunch at highway restaurants, vending machines dispensing Coca-Cola, cigarettes, and gasoline, as well as shopping centers and upscale buildings named after foreign banks.
